title: Lead Product Manager, Engagement
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US
 What You Will Do 
 We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the future of Lattice Engagement and help define what great employee listening looks like in the years ahead.
 Employee listening is a critical way HR leaders understand their organizations, build trust with employees, and turn feedback into action. As expectations for listening evolve, Lattice has an opportunity to make Engagement a more strategic, intelligent, and indispensable part of how companies lead.
 You’ll create the long-term strategy for Lattice Engagement and lead the first major iteration of that strategy from discovery through launch. You’ll join a cross-functional team ready to execute, and together you’ll build products that give HR leaders a clearer understanding of their people—and the confidence to act on what they learn.
 If you enjoy solving meaningful customer problems, developing a strong point of view, and turning strategy into high-impact products, you’ll love the impact you can have here. As a Lead Product Manager for Engagement, you will:
 Own the Engagement and employee-listening strategy. Define not only what we build next, but what the future of employee listening should mean for Lattice and the HR leaders we serve.
 Turn insight into action. Develop product experiences that help HR leaders gather meaningful feedback, understand what it reveals, and take action that improves the employee experience.
 Lead strategy. Drive discovery, prioritization, execution, launch, and iteration for the products that bring this vision to life.
 Build a deep understanding of customers. Partner with Research to understand the needs, workflows, and most important decisions of HR leaders, and use those insights to guide the roadmap.
 Partner closely with Engineering and Design. Translate customer problems and product strategy into clear, high-quality experiences that customers will want to use.
 Use data to sharpen decisions. Work with Data Science to identify opportunities, measure outcomes, and continually improve the product.
 Drive go-to-market readiness. Partner with Product Marketing to shape positioning, launches, and customer communication.
 Own outcomes. Set and influence the key results that show Engagement is creating value for customers and for Lattice.
 What You Will Bring to the Table 
 We’re looking for a product manager with the strategic instincts, customer empathy, and employee-listening expertise to shape the next generation of Lattice Engagement. You’ll be a great fit if you have a combination of:
 7+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS.
 Direct experience with employee engagement, surveys, employee listening, feedback, research, or insight products.
 A clear and informed point of view on the future of employee listening, including how product innovation can help organizations better understand and respond to their people.
 A track record of taking ambiguous, high-impact product problems from strategy through execution and measurable customer outcomes.
 Deep customer empathy and an ability to understand the priorities and challenges of HR leaders.
 Strong product judgment: you can balance a compelling long-term vision with the practical decisions required to ship meaningful work now.
 Excellent cross-functional communication and collaboration skills, especially with Engineering, Design, Research, Data Science, and Product Marketing.
 A bias for action and the ability to create clarity and momentum in an evolving space.
 Bonus: 
 Experience building products for HR, people teams, or other complex organizational workflows.
 Experience with AI-enabled research, feedback, analytics, or insight products.
 If you have strong experience in employee listening, survey products, or adjacent customer-insight domains—even if you do not meet every preferred qualification—we encourage you to apply. We’re looking for a strong product thinker with a meaningful perspective on the future of employee listening, not a perfect resume.
 ___
 The estimated annual cash salary for this role is $179,000 - $220,000. This position is also eligible for incentive stock options, subject to the terms of Lattice’s applicable plans. 
 Benefits: The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical insurance; Dental insurance; Vision insurance; Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance; Emergency Weather Support; Wellness Apps; Paid Parental Leave, Paid Time off inclusive of holidays and sick time; Commuter & Parking Accounts; Lunches in the Office; Internet and Phone Stipend; One time WFH Office Set-Up Stipend; 401(k) retirement plan; Financial Planning; Learning & Development Budget. 
 *Note on Pay Transparency: 
 Lattice provides an estimate of the compensation for roles that may be hired as required by state regulations. Compensation may vary based on (a) location, as Lattice factors in specific location when benchmarking compensation for most roles; (b) individual candidate skills and qualifications; and (c) individual candidate experience. 
 Additionally, Lattice leverages current market data to determine compensation, so posted compensation figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Lattice reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

title: Chief of Staff, CTO
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA
 Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  Learn more about working at Coinbase .
 The CTO organization spans 700+ people across Platform, AI, Engineering, Enterprise Engineering and IT. The Chief of Staff to the CTO is a one-person force multiplier. You own the CTO's time, attention, decisions, and follow-through, and increasingly you build the AI agents that run their operating system. 
 What you'll do 
 Own the CTO's operating system: how their week, preparation, and decisions flow, with a running decision and commitment log so decisions get made once, stick, and each follow-up has a named owner.
 Be where they cannot be: represent them in forums and cross-functional discussions across Platform, AI, Engineering, Core, and the executive team, bring back the signal, and unblock without escalation.
 Carry their voice: write and edit town halls, AMAs, all-hands remarks, board materials, and Slack posts so their point of view lands crisply and on time.
 Build and scale AI agents that absorb more of their operating system, freeing your hours for higher-leverage work.
 Run the few things they own that have no organizational home, from framing to clean handoff, without adding process.
 Required skills and experience 
 6+ years in BizOps, strategy, consulting, or technical program leadership, including support of a senior technical executive.
 Exceptional written and verbal communication: you can write in an executive's voice and turn technical trade-offs into business terms.
 Technical fluency: you follow architecture, infrastructure, and AI discussions with staff-plus engineers and ask the right questions. You do not need to be a practicing engineer.
 Judgment and discretion with sensitive org, people, and strategy information, and a clear read on what to escalate, decide, or let go.
 Influence without authority across senior engineering and cross-functional leaders, earned by being prepared and useful.
 Personal operating rigor: you track commitments and close loops relentlessly, without building process.
 Hands-on use of AI tools in your own work; experience in a platform, infrastructure, developer tooling, or AI-focused organization is a plus.
 Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.
   Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). 
 Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus): $212,330 — $249,800 USD 
 Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period.
 Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. 
 US Applicants: View Employee Rights , Know Your Rights , and E-Verify Notice of Participation. 
 Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial . 
 Data Privacy & Arbitration: By submitting your application, you agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice . US applicants: By submitting your application, you agree to Arbitration of Disputes .
 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/coinbase-chief-of-staff-cto

title: Product Manager (Senior/Staff) (d/f/m)
description:
Personio's intelligent HR platform helps small and medium-sized organizations unlock the power of people by making complicated, time-consuming tasks simple and efficient. Our team of 1,500 Personios is building user-friendly products that delight our 15,000+ customers and their 1.5 million employees. Ready to make an impact from day one?
 This role requires 2 days per week in the office and is based in Munich or Berlin.
Join us to shape the future of software in the underserved and high-impact HR technology industry. Your work will have a direct and tangible impact on customers, offering ownership and the chance to make a meaningful difference. As we prepare for significant growth, you'll face exciting challenges and have the opportunity to influence our path toward becoming one of the world's leading tech companies.
We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager, who will shape the vision, strategy, and execution of our product, keeping Personio at the forefront of HRM and Payroll software in Europe. We believe in a low level of managerial overhead where our senior product people are hands-on in building. This is a strategic, cross-functional role where you will work closely with Engineering, Design, Compliance and Salesbuilding a world-class HR software in Europe.
 What You'll Do
 Develop a deep understanding of the market as well as our customers, their pains and jobs-to-be-done
 Systematically analyze user feedback and usage data gathered qualitatively through customer interaction and from quantitative sources
 Create and align teams around strategic goals, relevant KPIs and a respective product roadmap often across Domain boundaries
 Plan, enable, and execute against a product roadmap based on an objectively prioritized backlog that spans multiple teams
 Lead specific complex topics within the product that extend across domain boundaries
 Decompose complex problems in close collaboration with Engineering and Design counterparts and write clear specifications that drive direction
 Manage product delivery in an agile setting and guide your team in all sprint activities
 What You Need To Suceed
 You have minimum of 6 years in product management within a B2B or B2C multi-product company, specializing in the development of global customer-facing products
 Background in fintech, accounting software, or other compliance-heavy product domains is a plus but not required
 You have a proven track record of navigating complex product areas, utilizing data, competitive intelligence, and user insights to define strategies and roadmaps
 You have demonstrated success in conceptualizing, developing, launching, and scaling platform-backed products within a fast-paced environment
 You use AI tools in your daily work (e.g., for research, synthesis, prototyping, or specs) and can show how they make you and your team faster
 You have strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to leverage data and metrics to support assumptions, formulate business cases, and establish OKRs
 You have the ability to think big yet pay attention to details, exhibiting a strong bias for action and the capacity to manage multiple competing priorities
 You have deep sense of accountability and ownership, fostering collaborative, result-oriented work
 Why Personio?
 Personio is an equal opportunities employer, committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. We embrace uniqueness and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. We are proud to have an inclusive workplace environment that will foster your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.
At Personio, we value in-person collaboration while also offering flexibility. This role is office-based, with 2 days per week required in your contracted office location. The remaining days can be worked from home or in the office if you prefer. In addition, you’ll have 20 Flex Days per year to work remotely from other locations.
Aside from our people, culture, and mission, check out some of the other benefits that make Personio a great place to work:
 Receive a competitive reward package – reevaluated each year – that includes salary, benefits, and pre-IPO equity
 Enjoy 28 days of paid vacation, plus an additional day after 2 and 4 years
 Make an impact on the environment and society with 1 (fully paid) Impact Day
 Receive generous family leave, child support, mental health support (including 24 sessions per year with Oli for yourself and 10 sessions for a significant other), and sabbatical opportunities
 We enjoy gathering for meals, cultural initiatives, and events like local Summer Sessions and year-end celebrations. There's also healthy snacks, drinks, and a weekly catered lunch.

title: Group Product Manager, Growth, Fintech, Dubai or Remote
description:
Emerald Zebra, on behalf of our client, a global regulated trading and fintech group, is looking to hire a Group Product Manager to lead its Growth tribe. Dubai is preferred for its closeness to the Product and Engineering teams. Remote, or hybrid from the group's other offices, will be considered for a strong profile.
 The Role 
 This is a product leadership role, not simply a more senior Product Manager title. You'll own the Growth tribe, covering Onboarding and Payments, line manage the Onboarding and Payments Product Managers and report directly to the VP of Product.
 The product team has moved to a tribe model, and this role creates the leadership layer each tribe needs. You'll own the tribe's strategy, outcomes and the quality of its product management, staying close enough to the work to challenge discovery, prioritisation and decisions, and making client onboarding and payments smooth, secure and efficient.
 What You'll Do 
 Own the Growth tribe's strategy, priorities and key outcomes across Onboarding and Payments.
 Line manage the Onboarding and Payments Product Managers, set expectations, coach them and keep the standard of their work high.
 Turn the wider product strategy into a clear vision and plan for the tribe, and evolve it as evidence and priorities change.
 Make sure the team talks to customers, uses internal insight and product analytics, and grounds its recommendations in evidence.
 Build a culture of hypothesis-led development and proportionate experimentation before committing significant engineering time.
 Define success metrics before launch, then review and act on performance afterwards.
 Lead the payments domain, including deposit and withdrawal journeys, PSP performance, routing, cascading and risk constraints.
 Work with Engineering, Business Analysis, UX/UI, Data, Operations, Compliance and Commercial to take validated ideas through delivery.
 Bring urgency and accountability: spot flat metrics or weak execution early, step in and keep senior stakeholders informed.
 Qualifications and Experience 
 A B2C product background. Candidates with a B2B product background will not be considered.
 Product leadership experience as a Group or Lead Product Manager, or as a Senior Product Manager already leading people and owning a wider product area.
 Genuine line management of Product Managers. This is not an individual contributor role.
 Payments experience is required: deposits and withdrawals, payment journeys, PSPs and gateways, routing, cascading, payment success and risk constraints.
 Strong onboarding, activation, conversion or other growth funnel experience.
 Specific examples of customer discovery, analytics, experimentation and measurable outcomes.
 The confidence to defend a product view with evidence in front of senior stakeholders.
 Retail FX or CFD trading experience is an asset but not essential. Strong backgrounds in fintech, payments, digital banking, wallets, crypto or iGaming are relevant.
 The Type of Person We're Looking For 
 A charismatic leader with strong stakeholder management skills.
 A strategic thinker who is still hands-on.
 High ownership and pace, stepping in when work is drifting or metrics are flat.
 Develops people and raises the standard of the Product Managers around them.
 Package and Benefits 
 Salary: EUR 6,000 to 8,000 gross per month
 Annual performance bonus
 Monthly cash flex benefit (taxable)
 Hybrid working for office-based hires: 3 days in the office and 2 days from home
 30 days per year remote working policy
 40 days annual leave including public holidays
 Private medical insurance, 100% covered for the employee and 50% for dependents
 Work permit support and costs covered for candidates based in Cyprus who need one
 Apply at the link or send your CV to tanya.malinouskaya@emeraldzebra.cy. All applications are handled in confidence by Emerald Zebra Specialist Recruitment and Executive Search, Cyprus.

title: Senior AI Product Manager - Remote - FTE
description:
Job Title: Senior AI Product Manager 
 Location: Vancouver, BC (Remote) 
 Duration: FTE/Perm 
 A reasonable, good faith estimate of the minimum and maximum for this position is CAD$150K/year to CAD$180K/year with benefits 
 Job Description:
 ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a Senior AI Product Manager to lead the charge in building the next generation of intelligent Procure-to-Pay automation. This is a pivotal opportunity to define and execute our AI vision, transforming how thousands of companies manage their spending by harnessing one of the most unique and comprehensive datasets in the industry.
 You will be responsible for turning cutting-edge AI concepts into tangible customer value, creating features that deliver unprecedented efficiency by reasoning over multimodal data (e.g. invoices, PDFs, emails, and user queries). You will join a world-class, cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and designers dedicated to shipping impactful, AI-powered products.
 WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON 
 Define the AI Product Vision & Strategy: You will own the AI product roadmap. You'll identify the most impactful opportunities for intelligence, from intake automation to complex compound AI systems, including the orchestration of multiple specialized agents, to manage the entire procurement lifecycle.
 Lead the Data-for-AI Strategy: You will determine how we leverage our most valuable asset, our proprietary data, to build a defensible competitive advantage. This includes identifying and structuring data for use with foundation models and ensuring the quality and integrity that fuel our AI experiences.
 Drive Product Discovery & Validation: You will immerse in customer workflows to uncover their most challenging problems. You will lead rapid, feedback-driven prototyping cycles with emerging technologies (LLMs, RAG) to validate new use cases and de-risk our technical investments.
 Own the End-to-End Product Lifecycle: You will guide AI features from initial concept through to launch and iteration. You will define success metrics that connect model performance to user value, and partner with Engineering to ensure our features are scalable, reliable, and responsible.
 Gather Customer Feedback: Establish ongoing feedback mechanisms with customers to monitor AI behavior in order to continuously fine-tune performance and user trust.
 Drive Go-to-Market & Adoption: You will partner closely with our Go-to-Market teams (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success) to articulate the value of our AI solutions, drive market adoption, and solidify our position as a leader in intelligent procurement.
 Nice to have: Experience as a product manager on an AI enablement team, fostering adoption of AI capabilities across diverse product areas and teams with varying levels of AI maturity.
 WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 
 Product Leadership Experience: 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2+ years focused on building and launching AI/ML-powered or data-intensive products.
 Technical Fluency: 
 A deep understanding of the machine learning lifecycle (e.g. data sourcing, model evaluation, MLOps) sufficient to drive credible, in-depth discussions with engineering and data science teams.
 Hands-on familiarity with modern AI paradigms, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic systems.
 Metrics Driven Approach: 
 Experience developing novel metrics and evaluation frameworks for AI products that connect model performance to user satisfaction and business outcomes.
 AI at Scale: 
 Experience designing enterprise-grade Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) systems that balance automation with user control and verification.
 A track record of shipping complex products at scale, with a demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and turn emergent technical capabilities into a strategic product advantage.
 Strategic Influence & Communication: Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with the ability to build alignment across the company, from the engineering team to the executive suite, and lead through influence.
 Domain Expertise: Experience in a B2B SaaS environment, particularly in FinTech, Procure-to-Pay, or a related domain.
 For customer-facing roles, maintains an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensures it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect their role and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.

title: Technical Project Manager (Platform) - Remote Work | REF#305720
description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.
Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.
When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.
Technical Project Manager (Platform) at BairesDev
As a Technical Project Manager (Platform), you will lead the execution of complex platform-driven initiatives by coordinating cross-functional teams and managing technical dependencies. You will streamline delivery processes and ensure that engineering teams remain unblocked and aligned with organizational goals through efficient, high-impact coordination.
 What You'll Do
 Drive project execution by managing dependencies, stakeholders, and delivery plans across multiple platform teams.
 Maintain and share deep platform knowledge to facilitate smooth technical coordination and ensure accurate project documentation.
 Prioritize asynchronous communication and documentation to ensure efficient project flow while minimizing the need for synchronous meetings.
 Track technical requirements, progress, and dependencies using JIRA, Confluence, and JQL.
 Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks to unblock development teams and ensure the timely delivery of platform features.
 Manage high-quality project documentation and stakeholder communication using Slack and Google Workspace.
 What We Are Looking For
 4+ years of experience in Technical Project Management, specifically within platform or infrastructure engineering environments.
 Proven expertise in driving project execution by managing complex dependencies and delivery plans across multiple teams.
 Proficiency in using JIRA and Confluence for project tracking, documentation, and managing team workflows via JQL.
 Strong background in facilitating asynchronous communication and coordination using tools like Slack and Google Workspace.
 Demonstrated ability to maintain platform knowledge and unblock engineering teams.
 Advanced proficiency in English.
 How we do make your work (and your life) easier:
 100% remote work (from anywhere).
 Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred
 Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.
 Flexible hours: create your own schedule.
 Paid parental leaves, vacations, and national holidays.
 Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.
 Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.
 Join a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive and make a significant impact!
Apply now!
